name: Dal with Tempering (Tadka Dal)
description: Dal with tempering, also called tadka dal, is a common Indian dish made with lentils. The dal is cooked until soft, and then hot oil with spices is added on top. This tempering gives strong aroma and flavor. It is usually eaten with rice or roti and is healthy, cheap, and easy to prepare.

name: Jeera Rice
description: Jeera rice is a simple rice dish flavored with cumin seeds. It smells good, tastes light, and goes well with dal or curry.

name: Tamarind Rice
description: Tamarind rice is a popular South Indian dish with a tangy and slightly spicy taste. It is useful for lunch boxes and travel meals.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Chicken curry is a rich and flavorful dish made with chicken, onions, tomatoes, and spices. It tastes good with rice or chapati.

name: Egg Curry
description: Egg curry is a simple dish made with boiled eggs in a spicy onion and tomato gravy. It is a filling meal with basic ingredients.

name: Laddu
description: Laddu is a round Indian sweet often made during festivals and celebrations. It is sweet, soft, and rich.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Gulab jamun is a famous Indian sweet made from soft dough balls that are fried and soaked in sugar syrup.

name: Semiya
description: Semiya is a sweet dish made with vermicelli, milk, and sugar. It is soft and comforting.

name: Halwa
description: Halwa is a soft and warm Indian sweet. It is easy to make and has a rich taste because of ghee and sugar.

name: Jeera Water
description: Jeera water is a light and simple drink made with cumin seeds and water. It is refreshing and soothing.

name: Buttermilk
description: Buttermilk is a cool and simple drink that is perfect for hot weather. It is light, refreshing, and easy to make.

name: Lemon Soda
description: Lemon soda is a refreshing drink made with lemon, soda, salt, and sugar. It is quick to prepare.

name: Lassi
description: Lassi is a cool and refreshing yogurt drink. It is smooth, simple, and perfect for hot days.

name: Sharbath
description: Sharbath is a sweet and colorful drink for warm days. It is simple to make and is liked by many people.
